✅ 7. INSTALL.md

`

Installation Guide — Linux-PERFORMANCE

🧱 Requirements
- Linux Mint
- sudo privileges
- Internet connection

📥 Clone the repository
`
git clone https://github.com/teremuhamblin/Linux-PERFORMANCE (github.com in Bing)
cd Linux-PERFORMANCE/scripts
`

🚀 Run the full pipeline
`
sudo bash 1_mint-install.sh
sudo bash 2_mint-tools.sh
sudo bash 3_mint-setup.sh
sudo bash 4_mint-perf.sh
sudo bash 5_mint-sec.sh
sudo bash 6_mint-desktop.sh
`

🧪 Verification
Check logs in:
`
logs/
`

🛠 Troubleshooting
See:
- SUPPORT.md
- bug_report.md
`
